name: anti-ai-slop
title: Anti-AI-Slop
description: Actively detect and remove generic AI website patterns: filler phrasing, invented claims, fabricated testimonials, template sections, decorative effects.
when_to_use: Always, for any client-facing copy or site.
instructions: Remove filler phrasing ("elevate", "seamless", "unlock", "cutting-edge"...) and write specifically.
No statistics, years, ratings, awards, guarantees or testimonials unless they are confirmed facts; use [[PLACEHOLDER: ...]] and list them.
No repeated template sections, meaningless gradients, stacked glassmorphism, random 3D or animation without purpose.
